test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 16 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the main role of the State Finance Commission?

options.text: To secure the accountability of the executive to the Parliament in the sphere of financial administration.
To advise the government on the legal financial matters referred to it by the President.
The distribution and determination of the net proceeds of taxes, tolls and fees between the state and local bodies.
To look after the elections of the panchayats and municipalities and also provide fund for that elections.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The main role of the State Finance Commission (SFC) is to assess the financial resources of a state and its local bodies, and recommend how to distribute funds between them: 
 
• The SFC reviews the financial situation of the state and its local bodies. 
 
• The SFC recommends how to distribute funds from the state to its local bodies. 
 
• The SFC suggests ways to improve the delivery of services to the public. 
 
• The SFC monitors and strengthens the financial condition of local governments. 
 
• The SFC advises the governor on how to divide tax revenues between the state and its local bodies. 
 
• The SFC is present in all states and union territories of India, except for Meghalaya, Mizoram, and Nagaland
